The '''Royal District''' was a district of [[Geharr]], a major [[City/Legends|city]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ord Gimmel/Legends|Ord Gimmel]]. It contained the [[Geharran Royal Palace]]. The district was protected by thousands of guards.<ref name="Strongholds" />
